entries.name: MicroStrategy Intelligence Server
entries.definition: The server component of MicroStrategy's business intelligence software that runs queries, caches results and serves reports to users.

entries.name: MicroStrategy metrics
entries.definition: In MicroStrategy, the objects that define business calculations, such as total revenue, which reports and dashboards display.

entries.name: MicroStrategy Office
entries.definition: A MicroStrategy add-in that lets users run and analyse MicroStrategy reports inside Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word.

entries.name: MicroStrategy OLAP Services
entries.definition: A MicroStrategy extension that lets users slice and filter report results held in memory without re-querying the database.

entries.name: MicroStrategy Report Services
entries.definition: A MicroStrategy component for building formatted, multi-section documents and dashboards from several reports.

entries.name: MicroStrategy Software Development Kit
entries.definition: A set of programming interfaces and tools for customising and extending MicroStrategy applications.

entries.name: MicroStrategy Transaction Services
entries.definition: A MicroStrategy feature that lets users write data back to a database from reports and documents.

entries.name: MicroStrategy Visual Insight
entries.definition: A MicroStrategy interface for building interactive data visualisations and dashboards.

entries.name: MicroStrategy Web
entries.definition: The web interface of MicroStrategy's business intelligence software, used to run reports and build dashboards in a browser.

entries.name: MIKE URBAN
entries.definition: DHI software for modelling urban water systems such as sewers, stormwater drainage and water distribution.

entries.name: Military standards and specifications
entries.definition: US Department of Defense documents, such as MIL-STD and MIL-SPEC, that set technical, quality and process requirements for defence products.

entries.name: Mill test report
entries.definition: A document from a metal mill that certifies the chemical and mechanical properties of a batch of material supplied with it.

entries.name: Millimeter waves
entries.definition: Radio waves with wavelengths of about 1 to 10 millimetres (30 to 300 GHz), used in 5G, radar and imaging.

entries.name: Mind mapping
entries.definition: Organising ideas as a branching diagram that spreads out from one central concept.

entries.name: Mineralogy
entries.definition: The study of minerals, including their composition, structure, properties and occurrence.

entries.name: MITRE ATT&CK
entries.definition: A knowledge base from MITRE of the tactics and techniques that attackers use, organised for threat modelling and defence.

entries.name: Mixed reality
entries.definition: Technology that blends real and virtual objects so that they interact in real time.

entries.name: Mobile application design
entries.definition: Designing the screens, navigation and interactions of apps for phones and tablets.

entries.name: Mobile computing
entries.definition: Computing on portable devices such as smartphones and tablets that connect wirelessly.

entries.name: Mobile UI design
entries.definition: Designing the visual look and controls of the screens of mobile apps.

entries.name: Mobile UX design
entries.definition: Designing how people find, use and experience apps on phones and tablets.

entries.name: ModelOps
entries.definition: The practice of deploying, monitoring and governing AI and machine-learning models in production.

entries.name: Models for life contingencies
entries.definition: Actuarial models that value insurance and annuity benefits depending on whether a person lives or dies.

entries.name: ModelSim
entries.definition: A hardware description language simulator from Mentor Graphics (now Siemens) for testing VHDL and Verilog designs.

entries.name: Modern methods of construction
entries.definition: Building approaches, such as offsite and modular manufacture, that move much of the construction work from the site into a factory.

entries.name: MODO
entries.definition: 3D modelling, animation and rendering software, originally from Luxology and now made by Foundry.

entries.name: Moist heat sterilization
entries.definition: Killing microorganisms on equipment or materials with pressurised steam, usually in an autoclave.

entries.name: Mold setting
entries.definition: Mounting a mould in a moulding machine and adjusting it and the machine settings so parts can be produced.

entries.name: Molding
entries.definition: Shaping a material such as plastic, metal or rubber by pouring or forcing it into a mould.

entries.name: Moldings installation and maintenance
entries.definition: Fitting and repairing decorative trim such as baseboards and crown moldings in buildings.

entries.name: Molecular docking
entries.definition: A computational method that predicts how a small molecule, such as a drug candidate, binds to a target protein.

entries.name: Molecular engineering
entries.definition: The design and building of materials and systems by controlling their structure at the molecular scale.

entries.name: Molecular modelling
entries.definition: Using computer methods to represent and predict the structure and behaviour of molecules.

entries.name: Molisch's test
entries.definition: A chemical test that detects carbohydrates by the purple ring that forms when alpha-naphthol and concentrated sulfuric acid are added.

entries.name: Moment.js
entries.definition: A JavaScript library for parsing, validating, manipulating and displaying dates and times.

entries.name: MonetDB
entries.definition: An open-source column-oriented relational database system designed for fast analytical queries.

entries.name: MongoEngine
entries.definition: A Python library that maps Python classes to MongoDB documents.

entries.name: Mongoose
entries.definition: A Node.js library that models application data and talks to MongoDB, adding schemas and validation.

entries.name: MongoVue
entries.definition: A Windows graphical client for browsing and querying MongoDB databases.

entries.name: Mortgage Electronic Registration System
entries.definition: An electronic registry that tracks ownership and servicing rights of mortgage loans in the United States.
